breezeway.incident_description: Meta reported an ads delivery error at 5:40 AM EDT. Reported that this was resolved at 7:47 AM EDT.
Meta reported an ads delivery error across Meta's platform and services at 6:34 AM EDT. Reported that this was resolved at 9:06 AM EDT.

macroEvents.description: US gas prices reverse course, start rising again to $3.84/gallon.
macroEvents.details: After steadily dropping since late May, the national average for a gallon of regular gasoline went up 5 cents overnight to $3.84 on July 9, 2026. This increase was attributed to uncertainty surrounding the ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran, pushing crude oil prices into the $70 per barrel range. Rising gas prices typically suppress discretionary spending as consumers allocate more of their budget to fuel. For a premium DTC food gifting brand, this could lead to a slight decrease in ROAS and an increase in CPA.

macroEvents.description: Mississippi kicks off Back-to-School Sales Tax Holiday.
macroEvents.details: Mississippi began its back-to-school tax-free shopping days on July 10, 2026, as one of 17 states offering sales tax exemptions. These holidays waive state sales tax on qualifying school supplies, clothing, and other items. While Gardner's Wisconsin Cheese is not a school supply brand, the general increase in consumer spending and shopping intent around these early tax holidays can create a more active e-commerce environment. This could lead to a slight boost in Meta ROAS and a decrease in CPA for gifting brands.

macroEvents.description: Meta's AI ad tools cause 'chaotic' results for advertisers.
macroEvents.details: A Business Insider report on July 13, 2026, highlighted widespread issues with Meta's AI advertising features, which were generating 'strangely twisted limbs, gibberish writing, or entirely changed products.' Advertisers reported bugs that accidentally toggled AI settings on, leading to misrepresentations and absurdities in ad creatives. These platform issues can negatively impact ad effectiveness and brand perception. For a DTC food brand, this could lead to lower ad engagement, reduced conversion rates, decreased ROAS, and increased CPA.

macroEvents.description: DHS issues final rule to end foreign student visa 'duration of status' loophole.
macroEvents.details: On July 16, 2026, the Department of Homeland Security announced a final rule eliminating the 'duration of status' loophole for foreign students, exchange visitors, and media representatives, establishing a fixed period of admission. This aims to restore integrity to the immigration system and strengthen national security. While not directly impacting consumer spending, significant policy changes like this can contribute to a broader sense of political or social tension, potentially increasing 'doomscrolling' and diverting attention from product discovery on social feeds. This could lead to a slight decrease in Meta ROAS and an increase in CPA.

macroEvents.description: US air quality alerts due to Canadian wildfires in Northeast and Upper Midwest.
macroEvents.details: Dense smoke from Canadian wildfires brought air quality alerts to over 20 states in the Northeast and Upper Midwest on July 17, 2026, with air quality index readings climbing to hazardous levels in some cities. Major environmental events like widespread poor air quality can dominate local news and social media feeds, causing public concern and potentially reducing outdoor activities or general consumer mood. This 'doomscrolling' effect can displace product discovery, leading to lower conversion intent, decreased Meta ROAS, and increased CPA.

macroEvents.description: Florida begins month-long Back-to-School Sales Tax Holiday.
macroEvents.details: Florida's 2026 Back-to-School Sales Tax Holiday commenced on July 20, 2026, and extended through August 20, 2026, offering tax exemptions on clothing, school supplies, learning aids, and personal computers. This month-long event is a significant retail moment, driving increased consumer spending on essential and discretionary items for the upcoming school year. While not directly related to cheese, the heightened shopping activity and general consumer focus on deals can create a competitive ad environment. This could lead to increased CPMs, potentially lowering ROAS and increasing CPA for non-essential gifting items.

macroEvents.description: National average gas price jumps 16 cents, crosses $4.00/gallon.
macroEvents.details: On July 21, 2026, the national average for a gallon of regular gasoline jumped 16 cents from the previous week, officially crossing the $4.00 mark to $4.019. This spike was attributed to rising crude oil prices and volatility along the Strait of Hormuz. Elevated gas prices directly impact consumers' disposable income, leading to reduced spending on non-essential goods. For a premium DTC food gifting brand, this significant increase in a core household expense is expected to suppress spending, resulting in decreased Meta ROAS and increased CPA.

macroEvents.description: Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index falls to 90.8 in July.
macroEvents.details: The Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index decreased by 1.4 points to 90.8 (1985=100) in July 2026, down from an upwardly revised 92.2 in June. The Present Situation Index, reflecting current business and labor market conditions, fell for the third consecutive month to 114.9. This decline indicates growing consumer pessimism about the economy. Lower consumer confidence typically correlates with reduced discretionary spending. For a gifting brand, this is expected to suppress spending, leading to decreased Meta ROAS and increased CPA.

macroEvents.description: University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index rises to 55.2 in July.
macroEvents.details: The University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index rose to a final reading of 55.2 in July 2026, an 11.5% increase from June's 49.5, and its highest level since March. This improvement was driven by easing gas prices and broad-based gains across demographic groups, although sentiment remained 11% below a year ago. An uptick in consumer sentiment, even from a low base, can signal a slight increase in willingness to spend. For a DTC food gifting brand, this positive shift in consumer mood could contribute to a boost in Meta ROAS and a decrease in CPA.

macroEvents.description: US economy unexpectedly sheds 23,000 jobs in July; unemployment rate 4.1%.
macroEvents.details: The US economy unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in July 2026, following a downwardly revised 20,000 gain in June, and missing economists' forecasts for an 80,000 increase. The unemployment rate edged down slightly to 4.1% from 4.2% in June, but this was partly due to a falling labor force participation rate. This weak jobs report, released on August 7, signals a softening labor market and increased economic uncertainty. Negative employment news typically heightens consumer financial anxiety, leading to reduced discretionary spending. For a premium DTC food gifting brand, this is expected to suppress spending, resulting in decreased Meta ROAS and increased CPA.
macroEvents.source: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Kiplinger, Robert Half

macroEvents.description: Most states begin Back-to-School Sales Tax Holidays.
macroEvents.details: The first weekend of August (August 7–9, 2026) marks the start of back-to-school tax-free shopping days in most of the 17 participating US states, including Ohio. These holidays offer exemptions on clothing, school supplies, and instructional materials. This period represents a peak in back-to-school shopping activity, with consumers actively seeking deals. While Gardner's Wisconsin Cheese is not a direct beneficiary, the overall increase in retail focus and competitive advertising during this major shopping moment can lead to higher CPMs and a more challenging ad environment for non-essential goods. This could result in decreased Meta ROAS and increased CPA.
